title: ContentSniffing - Callback
description: Uses an hidden callback parameter as a JSONP callback. The callback function name is reflected without validation.

Content Sniffing - JSONP Callback

The callback (or q) parameter is reflected directly as the JavaScript callback wrapper function.

Param: ?callback= or ?q=
